parties.respondent: M/s Mohit Minerals Pvt. Ltd. Through Director

summary: The case concerns the constitutionality of two GST notifications levying Integrated Goods and Services Tax (IGST) on ocean freight in CIF imports. The key issues include whether IGST on ocean freight results in double taxation with customs duty, whether the import of goods via CIF constitutes an inter-state supply under the IGST Act, and whether the notifications amount to excessive delegation. The court examined the statutory framework of IGST, the role of the GST Council, and the nature of reverse charge mechanism. It held that the levy of IGST on ocean freight for CIF imports does not violate constitutional provisions or result in double taxation, as IGST and customs duty are levied on different aspects of the transaction—service and goods, respectively. The notifications were upheld as intra vires and valid.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed in part; impugned notifications upheld as constitutional and intra vires; levy of IGST on ocean freight in CIF imports valid and not liable to be struck down.
